inspiration.observed_pattern: A three-way NATURAL JOIN chain reuses shared column names across successive relations.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to three independently authored tables sharing id and zone_code. One row matches all three relations on both shared names; a same-id row with a different zone_code must be rejected.

fixture_notes: Only id 1 matches all three tables because both id and zone_code agree; id 2 is rejected by the middle table's mismatched zone_code.
determinism_notes: One fixed matching row is selected in id order. There are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE chain_left (id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, left_value VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE chain_middle (id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, middle_value VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE chain_right (id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, right_value VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT id, zone_code, left_value, middle_value, right_value FROM chain_left NATURAL JOIN chain_middle NATURAL JOIN chain_right ORDER BY id

checks.sql: SELECT id, zone_code, left_value FROM chain_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, zone_code, middle_value FROM chain_middle ORDER BY id
SELECT id, zone_code, right_value FROM chain_right ORDER BY id
